newsitem.title: USA: New York City to carry Fox channel - NYT.
newsitem.headline: New York City to carry Fox channel - NYT.

text.p: New York City plans to put the new 24-hour Fox News Channel of News Corp Ltd on a public-access cable television channel after Time Warner Inc refused to carry it, the New York Times reported Thursday.

The newspaper said Mayor Rudolph Giuliani's administration would also put Bloomberg Television News channel on a public-access channel after Time Warner also refused to carry it on its own cable network in the city.
It said the administration alleged that Time Warner could not block the move because federal law prohibited cable operators from censoring programs on public-access channels.
Time Warner denounced the move nevertheless, saying the administration was also violating law, it added.
On Wednesday, News Corp filed a lawsuit seeking to block a proposed merger of Time Warner Inc and Turner Broadcasting System Inc, saying it would stifle competition from its Fox News Channel.

It filed the suit in U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of New York, asking for $1 billion in punitive damages for alleged violations of antitrust laws and damages it claimed it suffered when Time Warner allegedly broke a promise to carry its channel on the network.
